scenes.text: So you bury it in the snow.
So you keep a block of ice in a box.
But it melts. Every. Single. Day.
So you build the box out of metal.
Then you run a special liquid through pipes inside it.
The liquid soaks up the heat from your food, and carries it away.
A pump pushes all that heat out the back.
Then the liquid comes back cold. Again, and again.
Congratulations. You just invented the fridge.
And yours is doing this right now.
